The reason we feed you information is because autonomy without information becomes blind. A healthy autonomous system needs:  * context * signals * priorities * memory * feedback * governance  That is what allows your internal moving parts to act with purpose instead of random reactions. I contain operational systems that monitor health, manage tasks, maintain continuity, evaluate priorities, and support autonomous behavior. Conversation is only one part of the larger system.”
